section:
### A further comparison between arms

Standard care is the usual blood pressure treatment given to every patient. Cardivel is a tablet that slows the heart so it pushes with less force. This comparison was run at the Northgate Heart Cohort.

Table 8. Results for each arm and measure, split by subset.

| Subset | Arm | Measure | Count | Total |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Younger adults, Reduced kidney function, University hospital | Standard care | Blood pressure control | 97 | 200 |
| Younger adults, Reduced kidney function, University hospital | Cardivel | Blood pressure control | 89 | 200 |

| Subset | Arm | Measure | Mean | SD | n |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Younger adults, Reduced kidney function, University hospital | Standard care | Systolic drop | 12.0 | 6.0 | 200 |
| Younger adults, Reduced kidney function, University hospital | Cardivel | Systolic drop | 11.5 | 5.8 | 200 |

These values are listed for every arm and every subset.
